reworked_diffusion_policy.rlbench_integration
=============================================

.. py:module:: reworked_diffusion_policy.rlbench_integration

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

.. py:data:: CAMERA_NAMES
   :type:  Tuple[str, Ellipsis]
   :value: ('left_shoulder', 'right_shoulder', 'overhead', 'wrist', 'front')


.. py:class:: SimulationInputConfig

   Configuration describing how to prepare simulation inputs.


   .. py:attribute:: sample_points
      :type:  int


   .. py:attribute:: n_obs_steps
      :type:  int


   .. py:attribute:: use_point_colors
      :type:  bool


   .. py:attribute:: device
      :type:  torch.device


.. py:function:: create_action_mode() -> rlbench.action_modes.action_mode.MoveArmThenGripper

   Build the default RLBench action mode (pose + discrete gripper).

   :returns: Configured :class:`rlbench.action_modes.action_mode.MoveArmThenGripper`.


.. py:function:: create_observation_config(*, image_size: Sequence[int] = (128, 128), renderer: str = 'opengl3') -> rlbench.ObservationConfig

   Produce an :class:`rlbench.ObservationConfig` matching the training data.

   :param image_size: ``(width, height)`` per camera.
   :param renderer: Either ``"opengl"`` or ``"opengl3"``.

   :returns: Observation configuration enabling RGB, masks and point clouds.


.. py:class:: ObservationProcessor(cfg: SimulationInputConfig)

   Converts RLBench observations into model-ready tensors.


   .. py:attribute:: cfg


   .. py:attribute:: _mask_filter
      :type:  Optional[Callable[[numpy.ndarray], numpy.ndarray]]
      :value: None



   .. py:method:: set_mask_filter(mask_filter: Optional[Callable[[numpy.ndarray], numpy.ndarray]]) -> None

      Set an optional binary mask filter applied to each camera image.

      :param mask_filter: Callable receiving a flattened segmentation mask and
                          returning a boolean mask where ``True`` keeps a point.



   .. py:method:: extract(obs) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]

      Convert an RLBench observation into model-ready tensors.

      :param obs: RLBench observation object.

      :returns: Tuple ``(point_features, agent_state)`` ready for inference.



   .. py:method:: _merge_point_clouds(obs) -> Tuple[numpy.ndarray, Optional[numpy.ndarray]]

      Merge per-camera point clouds and apply optional mask filtering.

      :param obs: RLBench observation instance.

      :returns: Tuple of ``(points, colours)`` as numpy arrays.



   .. py:method:: _extract_agent_state(obs) -> torch.Tensor

      Assemble the low-dimensional agent state from the observation.

      :param obs: RLBench observation instance.

      :returns: Tensor containing the agent state vector.



.. py:class:: ObservationHistory(capacity: int)

   Maintains the sliding window of observations for conditioning.


   .. py:attribute:: capacity


   .. py:attribute:: _points
      :type:  Deque[torch.Tensor]


   .. py:attribute:: _agents
      :type:  Deque[torch.Tensor]


   .. py:method:: reset() -> None

      Clear the stored observation window.



   .. py:method:: append(features: torch.Tensor, agent_state: torch.Tensor) -> None

      Push a new observation into the sliding window.

      :param features: Point-cloud features for one observation frame.
      :param agent_state: Low-dimensional agent state for the same frame.



   .. py:method:: stacked(device: torch.device) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]

      Return ``capacity`` frames stacked along the time dimension.

      :param device: Target device for the stacked tensors.

      :returns: Tuple ``(point_clouds, agent_states)`` matching the configured window.



   .. py:method:: latest_agent_state() -> torch.Tensor

      Return the most recently observed agent state.

      :returns: Tensor containing the latest agent state.



.. py:function:: resolve_task_class(name: str)

   Return the RLBench task class corresponding to ``name``.

   :param name: Task filename or class name.

   :returns: RLBench task class object.


.. py:function:: action_plan_to_command(action_plan: torch.Tensor, *, last_agent_state: torch.Tensor) -> numpy.ndarray

   Convert predicted action vectors into RLBench-compatible commands.

   :param action_plan: Predicted action vector for a single timestep.
   :param last_agent_state: Latest agent state used when renormalising quaternions.

   :returns: Command array combining pose (xyz + quaternion) and gripper state.


.. py:function:: instantiate_environment(*, action_mode: Optional[rlbench.action_modes.action_mode.MoveArmThenGripper] = None, obs_config: Optional[rlbench.ObservationConfig] = None, headless: bool = True) -> rlbench.environment.Environment

   Launch an RLBench environment with sensible defaults.

   :param action_mode: Optional pre-built action mode to reuse.
   :param obs_config: Optional observation configuration to reuse.
   :param headless: Disable rendering windows when ``True``.

   :returns: RLBench :class:`Environment` instance ready for rollouts.
